content.short: Neutrl issues NUSD, a market-neutral synthetic dollar earning yield from OTC altcoin arbitrage.
content.description: Neutrl is a synthetic dollar protocol whose NUSD and staked sNUSD earn yield by buying discounted altcoins in OTC markets and hedging them delta-neutral. It raised $5 million led by STIX and Accomplice, and uses LayerZero to reach many chains. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Neutrl.
content.meta: Neutrl issues NUSD, a market-neutral synthetic dollar with OTC arbitrage yield, listed on Plasma.
